claim.claim-text: 1. A receiver circuit (RC) for an ultrasonic flow meter, the receiver circuit (RC) comprising a receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA),
characterized in that: the receiver circuit (RC) comprising means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA).

2. An ultrasonic flow meter comprising a first and second ultrasonic transducers (TR1, TR2), a signal generator (SG) for generating an electrical transmission signal to the first transducer (TR1), and a receiver circuit (RC) according to claim 1 for receiving electrical reception signals from the second transducer (TR2).

3. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 1 or 2, wherein the means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) comprises a measuring amplifier (MA) comprising a measuring operational amplifier (MOA).

4. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of any of claims 1-3, wherein the means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) is arranged to determine a received ultrasonic signal from the measured power supply current and provide the determined received ultrasonic signal at a measurement output (MO) of the means for measuring a power supply current.

5. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of any of claims 1-4, wherein the means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) is arranged to measure a representation of an AC current drawn through at least one power supply terminal (V+, V-) of the receiving amplifier (RA).

6. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 5, wherein the means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) is coupled to said power supply terminal (V+, V-) through a measurement impedance (Zm), preferably at least one capacitor.

7. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 5 or 6, wherein the at least one power supply terminal (V+, V-) of the receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) is coupled to a power supply (VDD, VSS; VDD, GND) through a sense impedance (Zs).

8. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 7, wherein said sense impedance (Zs) is larger than 10% of said measurement impedance (Zm), preferably equal to or larger than said measurement impedance (Zm).
9. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 7 or 8, wherein said sense impedance (Zs) is a resistor, preferably less than 1 kOhm.

10. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of any of claims 1-9, wherein the means for measuring a power supply current to said receiving amplifier (RA; ROA; SOA) is implemented substantially as a transimpedance amplifier with a sense input connected to said power supply terminal (V+, V-).

11. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of any of claims 1-10, wherein the receiving amplifier (RA) is an operational amplifier (ROA; SOA) different from said measuring operational amplifier (MOA).

12. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 11, wherein the operational amplifier (ROA; SOA) has a first input, preferably a non-inverting input (+), connected to ground or to a reference potential, a second input, preferably an inverting input (-), and an output (O) connected to the second input (-) via a feedback connection, and wherein the output (O) is further connected to the second transducer (TR2).

13. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of claim 11 or 12, wherein a first receiver impedance (ZR1) between the receiving ultrasonic transducer (TR2) and an output of the receiving operational amplifier (ROA; SOA) is less than or equal to a second receiver impedance (ZR2) between the receiving ultrasonic transducer (TR2) and an inverting input of said receiving operational amplifier (ROA; SOA).

14. The receiver circuit or the ultrasonic flow meter of any of claims 1-13, wherein the signal generator (SG) and receiver circuit (RC) are formed by a combined signal generator and receiver circuit (SG/RC), the combined signal generator and receiver circuit (SG/RC) comprising a shared operational amplifier (SOA) as said receiving amplifier (RA).
